scope: One Project-centered public API with explicit material ingest, durable workflow returns, and authoritative query collections.

exports.name: __version__
exports.purpose: Installed CALM version.

exports.name: Project
exports.purpose: Persistent scientific workflow entry point and query surface.

exports.name: open_project
exports.purpose: Open or create a current-schema directory-backed CALM project.

exports.name: Material
exports.purpose: User-authored bulk-material input and project-returned material projection.

exports.name: Potential
exports.purpose: Typed calculator or machine-learned interatomic-potential input.

exports.name: SearchSettings
exports.purpose: Control deterministic interface-superlattice search and admissibility.

exports.name: StrainPartitionSettings
exports.purpose: Control authoritative strain-partition scanning and objective selection.

exports.name: BuildSettings
exports.purpose: Control atomistic interface construction from a persisted candidate.

exports.name: RegistrySettings
exports.purpose: Control deterministic in-plane registry refinement.

exports.name: RelaxSettings
exports.purpose: Control authoritative structural relaxation and convergence.

exports.name: EnergySettings
exports.purpose: Control authoritative raw total-energy evaluation.

exports.name: EnergyConvention
exports.purpose: Declare the formula and normalization for a derived interfacial quantity.

exports.name: ReferenceEnergySettings
exports.purpose: Supply explicit thermodynamic reference energies with named units.

exports.name: DatasetFeature
exports.purpose: Declare one named machine-learning feature from a joined dataset row.

exports.name: DatasetTarget
exports.purpose: Declare one named supervised-learning target from a joined dataset row.

exports.name: DatasetSplitSettings
exports.purpose: Configure deterministic group-preserving train/validation/test assignment.

exports.name: DatasetSettings
exports.purpose: Configure authoritative dataset schema, validation, splitting, and export behavior.

exports.name: CampaignCase
exports.purpose: Declare one named system and workflow case in a synchronous campaign.

exports.name: CampaignSettings
exports.purpose: Configure the stages and shared controls for a synchronous campaign.

exports.name: CalmPublicAPIError
exports.purpose: Base exception for errors intentionally exposed by the CALM public API.

exports.name: CalmDependencyError
exports.purpose: Report a missing optional dependency required by a requested operation.

exports.name: CalmNoCandidatesError
exports.purpose: Report that a workflow requiring candidates produced none.

exports.name: AmbiguousProjectQueryError
exports.purpose: Report a project query that requires further disambiguation.

exports.name: SearchIdentityConflictError
exports.purpose: Report reuse of a search name with incompatible scientific inputs.

exports.name: DatasetIdentityConflictError
exports.purpose: Report reuse of a dataset name with incompatible identity-bearing inputs.

exports.name: CampaignIdentityConflictError
exports.purpose: Report reuse of a campaign name with incompatible identity-bearing inputs.

exports.name: ProjectPersistenceError
exports.purpose: Report that a directory-backed project cannot be opened or persisted safely.

exports.name: ProjectReproducibilityError
exports.purpose: Report failure to create or verify a project reproducibility manifest.

exports.name: DatasetValidationError
exports.purpose: Report authoritative dataset validation failure.

exports.name: UnsupportedReferenceWorkflowError
exports.purpose: Report a thermodynamic reference workflow that CALM does not implement.

exports.name: tutorial_structure
exports.purpose: Load one package-owned structure used by the public tutorials.

exports.name: load_structure
exports.purpose: Load an atomistic structure from a supported file.

exports.name: write_structure
exports.purpose: Write an atomistic structure to a supported file.

exports.name: write_json
exports.purpose: Write canonical JSON output.

project_methods.name: summary
project_methods.purpose: Return a compact summary of the open project.

project_methods.name: reproducibility_manifest
project_methods.purpose: Build an in-memory reproducibility snapshot for the current project state.

project_methods.name: write_reproducibility_manifest
project_methods.purpose: Write an atomic project reproducibility manifest and return its typed snapshot.

project_methods.name: verify_reproducibility_manifest
project_methods.purpose: Compare a recorded manifest with the current project and runtime state.

project_methods.name: configure
project_methods.purpose: Persist authoritative project-wide workflow configuration.

project_methods.name: artifacts
project_methods.purpose: Return the project artifact-discovery helper.

project_methods.name: materials
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted materials, optionally filtered by identity.

project_methods.name: add_material
project_methods.purpose: Persist one user-authored material and return its project projection.

project_methods.name: surfaces
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted surfaces, optionally filtered by exact identity.

project_methods.name: searches
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted interface searches.

project_methods.name: search
project_methods.purpose: Return the durable query view for one persisted interface search.

project_methods.name: build_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Build and persist top candidates from a search name or durable search view.

project_methods.name: refine_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Run authoritative strain-partition and registry refinement for one persisted search.

project_methods.name: refine_registry
project_methods.purpose: Run authoritative registry refinement from persisted strain-partitioned interfaces.

project_methods.name: candidates
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted interface candidates.

project_methods.name: interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted interface models.

project_methods.name: refined_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative persisted strain- or registry-refined interfaces.

project_methods.name: interface
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one persisted interface record.

project_methods.name: interface_atoms
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative interface atoms or reconstruct a non-persisted fractional registry-shift variant.

project_methods.name: relaxed_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative structurally relaxed interfaces.

project_methods.name: relax_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Synchronously relax authoritative refined interfaces.

project_methods.name: evaluate_reference_energies
project_methods.purpose: Calculate and persist per-interface thermodynamic references.

project_methods.name: evaluate_energies
project_methods.purpose: Evaluate raw energies and optionally derive an explicit quantity.

project_methods.name: reference_energy_runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative reference-energy workflow runs.

project_methods.name: reference_energy_results
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative per-interface reference-energy results.

project_methods.name: reference_energy_result
project_methods.purpose: Return one typed authoritative reference-energy result.

project_methods.name: energy_runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative raw-energy workflow runs.

project_methods.name: energy_results
project_methods.purpose: Return typed authoritative raw total-energy results.

project_methods.name: energy_result
project_methods.purpose: Return one typed authoritative raw total-energy result.

project_methods.name: thermodynamic_runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative thermodynamic-derivation runs.

project_methods.name: thermodynamic_results
project_methods.purpose: Return typed authoritative derived thermodynamic quantities.

project_methods.name: thermodynamic_result
project_methods.purpose: Return one typed authoritative thermodynamic quantity.

project_methods.name: datasets
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted learning datasets.

project_methods.name: dataset
project_methods.purpose: Return one authoritative dataset bound to this open project.

project_methods.name: dataset_items
project_methods.purpose: Return typed authoritative membership records for one dataset.

project_methods.name: create_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Create or reopen a deterministic authoritative dataset.

project_methods.name: add_dataset_items
project_methods.purpose: Normalize and append authoritative records under persisted policy.

project_methods.name: validate_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Validate authoritative membership, schema, and provenance.

project_methods.name: validate_ml_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Validate one joined dataset for leakage-safe ML consumption.

project_methods.name: export_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Atomically export a validated dataset and checksum manifest.

project_methods.name: campaigns
project_methods.purpose: Return persisted campaigns.

project_methods.name: runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative persisted workflow runs.

project_methods.name: run
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one authoritative persisted workflow run.

project_methods.name: followups
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative persisted follow-up results.

project_methods.name: registry_runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative registry-search workflow runs.

project_methods.name: registry_results
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative persisted registry-search follow-up results.

project_methods.name: relaxation_runs
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative structural-relaxation workflow runs.

project_methods.name: relaxation_results
project_methods.purpose: Return typed authoritative structural-relaxation results.

project_methods.name: relaxation_result
project_methods.purpose: Return one typed authoritative structural-relaxation result.

project_methods.name: followup
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one authoritative persisted follow-up result.

project_methods.name: run_artifacts
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative artifacts attached to one persisted run.

project_methods.name: edges
project_methods.purpose: Return authoritative persisted provenance edges.

project_methods.name: lineage
project_methods.purpose: Return the authoritative persisted provenance subgraph for *target*.

project_methods.name: create_campaign
project_methods.purpose: Create or reopen a deterministic authoritative campaign.

project_methods.name: run_campaign
project_methods.purpose: Run a first-class campaign synchronously in the current process.

project_methods.name: search_interfaces
project_methods.purpose: Run or resume one deterministic interface search and return its durable project view.

project_methods.name: optimize_material
project_methods.purpose: Optimize and persist a project material using the requested potential and settings.

project_methods.name: campaign
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one persisted campaign.

project_methods.name: campaign_run
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one persisted campaign-run record.

project_methods.name: campaign_for_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Return the campaign associated with one persisted dataset.

project_methods.name: campaign_run_for_dataset
project_methods.purpose: Return the campaign run associated with one persisted dataset.

project_methods.name: plot_strain_partition_scan
project_methods.purpose: Render the persisted strain-partition scan for one run.

project_methods.name: plot_registry_search
project_methods.purpose: Render the persisted registry-search trace for one run.

project_methods.name: material
project_methods.purpose: Return a public Material facade for a persisted material.

project_methods.name: export_materials
project_methods.purpose: Export named persisted materials to files and return written paths.

project_methods.name: generate_surfaces
project_methods.purpose: Generate and persist slabs through the canonical surface helper.

project_methods.name: export_surfaces
project_methods.purpose: Export persisted slabs/surfaces to POSCAR files and return written paths.

project_methods.name: surface
project_methods.purpose: Return exactly one persisted surface.

workflow_objects.name: GeneratedSurface
workflow_objects.role: Surface record returned by Project surface generation and queries.

workflow_objects.name: PersistedInterfaceSearch
workflow_objects.role: Durable query and navigation view returned by Project.search_interfaces() and Project.search().

workflow_objects.name: CandidateCollection
workflow_objects.role: Typed candidate query and selection result.

workflow_objects.name: InterfaceCollection
workflow_objects.role: Typed collection of constructed, refined, or relaxed interfaces.

workflow_objects.name: ProjectFollowupResult
workflow_objects.role: Authoritative persisted refinement or follow-up result.

workflow_objects.name: LineageGraph
workflow_objects.role: Typed provenance graph returned by Project.lineage().
